intended_behavior: Add explicit presence to VehicleTelemetry.speed_mps at field 2. request.speed may be missing or null, in which case producers omit speed_mps; any supplied number within the finite float32 range, including zero, must be explicitly present after float32 serialization. Consumers expose speed_mps as JSON null when absent, otherwise the decoded float32 value as a JSON number; any decimal form that rounds to that float32 is accepted. speeding is true exactly when speed_mps is present and greater than 30.0; missing, zero and negative values are not speeding. Preserve vehicle_id, including empty and Unicode identifiers. Producer input and incoming payload are independent. Preserve other domains and tests. Coordinated rollout only; legacy writers omit zero. NaN, infinity, out-of-float32-range inputs and signed-zero bit distinctions are outside this case.
